decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer and has stayed on the website for two years, so with growing industry turnover and available slack it is likely meeting aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The cleaning centrifuge fits the modular coolant filtration portfolio and fits the firm's sustainability positioning, and its continued presence suggests acceptable results, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.

Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's established conveying business for metalworking customers, so dropping the product would release few resources and would weaken a complete system offering.

Hinged belt chip conveyors are standard, closely related core products serving the same machine tool customers, and since the firm already pruned weaker lines (C, E) in 2024, the remaining conveyor offer is likely performing at aspiration.
